## Design

### 2026-10-25 – i finished this project in one sitting so instead of telling you what i did do (which is all in the github repo) ill list the biggest "msitakes" i made, the first one was just misnaming the piano keys

**8.28h**

i finished this project in one sitting so instead of telling you what i did do (which is all in the github repo) ill list the biggest "msitakes" i made, the first one was just misnaming the piano keys and putting them the same as the push buttons, and choosing an esp32 module that didnt fit nearly enough pins and the one i did use still had to cut some parts because there wasnt anymore room left, and then i started designing the keys and started experimenting  a bit then when i finally settled on a design, saved the footprint and closed the window to assign the footprint, woops, its not there anymore, nothing was saved, you did all of that for nothing, and  you have to do it all over again. and i think thats going to be it for this journal i want ot go to sleep
